adjustment_policy.ohlc: Yahoo quote OHLC, split-adjusted by provider; no dividend adjustment applied by this pipeline
adjustment_policy.adjusted_close: Yahoo adjclose retained for audit only; never substituted for close
adjustment_policy.dividends: USD per share on provider ex-date; preserved, not credited by this pipeline
adjustment_policy.splits: No splits reported in this sample; reject a source that reports any, pending explicit handling

adjustment_policy.availability: Scheduled close is a bar label, not a guarantee of provider publication time; trade no earlier than next session
adjustment_policy.missing_sessions: Reject; do not fill or interpolate
adjustment_policy.rounding: Preserve provider floating point values without rounding
